verdict.rationale: Privacy posture around AI training is a fair question for a payments and agentic-commerce platform that handles consumer data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training data use or an opt-out. The documented consent capture covers agent payment mandates and checkout data sharing, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
